question: Where should the great-souled Viṣṇu be placed after meditation?
premises: Viṣṇu is the object of meditation.
The filaments are the specified location for placement.
inference: After meditating on the great-souled Viṣṇu, one should place him in the filaments.
plain_english: Having meditated on the great-souled Viṣṇu, one should place him in the filaments.
